desc: Ideation: model valid parenthesis sequences as rooted ordered forests; operation mirrors sibling forests, so reachable strings are all plane embeddings of the fixed unordered tree/forest.

Implement the complete Python solution: precompute factorials/invfact modulo 998244353, parse S with a stack of child-type lists, intern unordered subtree type IDs by sorting child IDs, multiply the multinomial factor deg! / product(count!) for every completed node and the dummy root, and print the answer.
Validate the implementation on the samples and small brute-force cases, including single pair, nested chains, repeated identical subtrees, and top-level forests.
